title: Finite-horizon predictors for a frozen contextual linear learner

assumptions.gaussian: x ~ N(0,I); observed discrete context; conditionally linear target; independent label noise
assumptions.plugin: Context vectors/frequencies, conditional target coefficients and unbiased noise variances estimated using calibration only
assumptions.oracle: True generating context vectors, uniform probabilities, target coefficients and label-noise variance; privileged diagnostic
assumptions.empirical: Exact GD on first 512 calibration rows; risk on remaining 512; surrogate for 2048-cache SGD
assumptions.fresh_sgd: Exact population moment recurrence for fresh iid minibatches; finite-cache use is model misspecification
assumptions.pilot: Sixteen actual training steps on every candidate, evaluated on calibration observations; extra candidate-training cost is measured

population_comparison: Both finite-cache and fresh-example SGD; common held-out test and paired candidate sampling
inference: 20 independent seed blocks, conditions averaged within seed; 10000 whole-seed bootstrap resamples
outcomes: Retain all candidates, ranks, noises, angles, arms and training regimes; no endpoint-dependent exclusions
tuning: No new fitted selector hyperparameters; original scalar/rank/fixed choices read unchanged from original development fit
status: Frozen before fresh calibration or training outcomes
